register.description: Priority Channel Configuration.

bitfield.description: Enable priority channel. Enable one channel to be prioritize - no round rubin would be done
First priority channel. channel with highest prioriry
Second priority channel. channel with second highest prioriry

Maximum consecutive priority blocks. Maximum consecutive block transactions of "priority channels" . After this number of consecutive blocks one of "roubd robin" channels will win arbitration. 31 means there is no limitation on number of consecutive priority blocks

register.description: Channel Status FSM state and run indication.

bitfield.description: HW event status. Channel status is a bit mask. Multiple bits can be set at the same time 0. PROCESSING 1. TRANS DONE 2. ABORT 4. EXCEPTION
FSM state: 0x0. IDLE 0x2. EXCEPTION 0x3. DRAIN 0x4. ABORT 0x8. PENDING ARB 0x9. COPY 0xA. COPY LAST 0xC. DONE 0xD. SAVE CTX 0xE. WAIT NEXT TRANS 0xF. LAST
Indication that channel is currently transfering data and is not idle. Channels that are waiting on arbitration are considered running.

register.description: Input Pointer Channel Transaction. 32 bit address pointer of channel current input.

bitfield.description: Transaction input pointer. 32 bit address pointer of channel current input.

register.description: Output Pointer Channel Transaction. 32 bit address pointer of channel current output.

bitfield.description: Transaction output pointer. 32 bit address pointer of channel current output.

register.description: Transaction control

bitfield.description: Transaction bytes number. Number of bytes of the transaction to move from source to destination.

Use burst request. In case number of words to tranfer smaller than block size, DMA would use signle request and work with block size of 1 word. In case we know request would be set on altough number of words to tranfer is smaller than block size, we can set this field on and DMA will wait for block_request and transact all remaining words in one block.
0 -no endianess, 1 - byte endianess, 2 - bit endianess

register.description: DMA command interface

bitfield.description: 1 - run command. Start a transaction. 2- abort command - stop reansaction. 4- init command - init new transaction afet abort/error. Type:Write-Clear.

register.description: Transaction Status. Job completion reason - either last transaction or exception

bitfield.description: channel OCP rstatus recieved at one of the primary ports. Once an error is encountered the channel will enter an Exception state and stay the until an init command is recieved. ICLR does not affect this status.
Word offset. Offset in words from block boundary. Actually number of word have been transferred in this block
Remain bytes number. Number of bytes remaining to complete the transaction.

register.description: Job control register

bitfield.description: 00 -word size is 32 bits 01 -word size is 16 bits 10 -word size is 8 bits

size of the block in words. If block mode is enabled, defines the address wrap around. Since channel arbitration decisions are made every block, this also effect how much bandwidth is given to a specific channel.
source pointer wrap around mode 0: no wrap around(non block mode) 1: with wrap around(block mode)
Destination pointer wrap around mode 0: no wrap around(non block mode) 1: with wrap around(block mode)
Tie high channel DMA req signal. This is useful for memory to memort transaction
Source pointer fifo mode
Destination pointer fifo mode
0 - Sorce is periph: transaction from periph to memory. 1 - Destination is periph :transaction from Memory to periph
Enable DMA to set a rd/wr clear pulse at the beginning of a job (one cycle after run cmd)
